title: The Iron Seed
text: A seed of iron lies in a cold crucible, no bigger than an acorn, dull and heavy. When warmed in the hand, it stirs. A tiny root uncurls from it, red as rust and thin as a hair, feeling for something to grow into.

options.label: Plant it in the forge's ashes, where it belongs.

outcomes.text: A sapling of iron rises from the ashes. The ruins feel a little less dead around it.

options.label: The wisest keeps it close, curious what it will grow into.

outcomes.text: Over the days it grows into something worth having, its roots curled tight against their skin.

options.label: Melt it down. Iron that grows roots wants something.

outcomes.text: It makes good iron. Still, everyone feels they have killed something small.
